mapper.select: SELECT s.artist_id AS singerId, si.name AS singerName, COUNT(*) AS playCount FROM user_song_play_record r JOIN `shining-music`.songs s ON r.song_id = s.id LEFT JOIN `shining-music`.singers si ON s.artist_id = si.id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY s.artist_id, si.name ORDER BY playCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT HOUR(played_at) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM user_song_play_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY HOUR(played_at) ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG( CASE WHEN completed = 1 THEN 100.0 WHEN total_duration > 0 AND duration_sec > 0 THEN LEAST(duration_sec * 100.0 / total_duration, 100.0) ELSE NULL END ) FROM user_song_play_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (completed IS NOT NULL OR (duration_sec IS NOT NULL AND total_duration IS NOT NULL))
SELECT song_id AS songId, COUNT(*) AS playCount FROM user_song_play_record GROUP BY song_id ORDER BY playCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
